name: projects/tmrw-wildfire-20261015/locations/us-central1/workflows/fds-science-recovery
sourceContents:
main:
  steps:
  - initialize:
      assign:
      - deadline: ${sys.now() + 900}
      - job:
          taskGroups:
          - taskCount: '1'
            parallelism: '1'
            taskCountPerNode: '1'
            taskSpec:
              computeResource:
                cpuMilli: 4000
                memoryMib: 12000
              maxRunDuration: 600s
              maxRetryCount: 0
              runnables:
              - container:
                  imageUri: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/tmrw-wildfire-20261015/fds/study15@sha256:4cc533e7da1a88aa10d8d8f01fdb03c2b2fa982c0fba3940c8da6e8ab1b59c3f
                  entrypoint: python3
                  commands:
                  - -c
                  - 'import base64,pathlib,runpy; payload={''study.py'': '''',
                    ''worker.py'': ''''};
                    [pathlib.Path(''/study'',n).write_bytes(base64.b64decode(v)) for
                    n,v in payload.items()]; runpy.run_path(''/study/worker.py'',run_name=''__main__'')'
                  options: --cpus=4 --memory=12g --pids-limit=256
                environment:
                  variables:
                    TRIAL_MODE: science
                    OUTPUT_BUCKET: tmrw-wildfire-20261015-trial
                    OUTPUT_PREFIX: science-recovery
          allocationPolicy:
            instances:
            - policy:
                machineType: c3-standard-4
                provisioningModel: SPOT
                bootDisk:
                  sizeGb: '30'
                  type: pd-balanced
            location:
              allowedLocations:
              - zones/us-central1-a
            serviceAccount:
              email: fds-worker@tmrw-wildfire-20261015.iam.gserviceaccount.com
            labels:
              trial_id: study15
            network:
              networkInterfaces:
              - network: projects/tmrw-wildfire-20261015/global/networks/fds-trial
                subnetwork: projects/tmrw-wildfire-20261015/regions/us-central1/subnetworks/fds-trial
          labels:
            trial_id: study15
          logsPolicy:
            destination: CLOUD_LOGGING
      - status:
          body:
            status:
              state: UNKNOWN
  - create:
      call: http.post
      args:
        url: https://batch.googleapis.com/v1/projects/tmrw-wildfire-20261015/locations/us-central1/jobs
        query:
          jobId: fds-controlled-trial
        auth:
          type: OAuth2
        body: ${job}
      result: created
  - monitor:
      try:
        steps:
        - get_status:
            call: http.get
            args:
              url: https://batch.googleapis.com/v1/projects/tmrw-wildfire-20261015/locations/us-central1/jobs/fds-controlled-trial
              auth:
                type: OAuth2
            result: status
        - check:
            switch:
            - condition: ${status.body.status.state == "SUCCEEDED" or status.body.status.state
                == "FAILED"}
              next: record
            - condition: ${sys.now() >= deadline}
              next: record
        - wait:
            call: sys.sleep
            args:
              seconds: 15
            next: get_status
      except:
        as: monitor_error
        steps:
        - monitor_failure:
            call: sys.log
            args:
              text: Monitoring failed; proceeding to cleanup
              severity: ERROR
  - record:
      try:
        call: http.post
        args:
          url: https://storage.googleapis.com/upload/storage/v1/b/tmrw-wildfire-20261015-trial/o
          query:
            uploadType: media
            name: science-recovery/job-status.json
          auth:
            type: OAuth2
          headers:
            Content-Type: application/json
          body: ${status.body}
      except:
        as: record_error
        steps:
        - record_failure:
            call: sys.log
            args:
              text: Could not persist final status; proceeding with cleanup
              severity: ERROR
  - delete_job:
      try:
        call: http.delete
        args:
          url: https://batch.googleapis.com/v1/projects/tmrw-wildfire-20261015/locations/us-central1/jobs/fds-controlled-trial
          auth:
            type: OAuth2
        result: deletion
      except:
        as: delete_error
        steps:
        - delete_failure:
            call: sys.log
            args:
              text: Batch deletion failed; checking workers directly
              severity: ERROR
  - cleanup_wait:
      call: sys.sleep
      args:
        seconds: 30
  - list_workers:
      call: http.get
      args:
        url: https://compute.googleapis.com/compute/v1/projects/tmrw-wildfire-20261015/zones/us-central1-a/instances
        query:
          filter: labels.trial_id = study15
        auth:
          type: OAuth2
      result: workers
  - delete_stragglers:
      for:
        value: vm
        in: ${default(map.get(workers.body, "items"), [])}
        steps:
        - delete_vm:
            call: http.delete
            args:
              url: ${"https://compute.googleapis.com/compute/v1/projects/tmrw-wildfire-20261015/zones/us-central1-a/instances/"
                + vm.name}
              auth:
                type: OAuth2
  - verify_wait:
      call: sys.sleep
      args:
        seconds: 30
  - verify:
      call: http.get
      args:
        url: https://compute.googleapis.com/compute/v1/projects/tmrw-wildfire-20261015/zones/us-central1-a/instances
        query:
          filter: labels.trial_id = study15
        auth:
          type: OAuth2
      result: remaining
  - assert_empty:
      switch:
      - condition: ${len(default(map.get(remaining.body, "items"), [])) > 0}
        raise: 'Cleanup incomplete: labeled workers remain'
  - done:
      return:
        mode: science-recovery
        final_state: ${status.body.status.state}
        workers_remaining: 0
        job_uid: ${created.body.uid}
